Manage Topics Guides PS5 Release Dates Features These 13+ PS5 and PS Plus Games Are Coming Out Next Week (16th-22nd November) GTA 6! GTA 6! GTA 6! by Stephen Tailby 3 hours ago Share: Look, I'm gonna be real with you: GTA 6 is coming out next week, and you can tell. Rockstar's juggernaut arrives on PS5 at long last, and it's sent nearly every other game running for the hills. However, there are a few brave titles making their debut in its vicinity, including colourful co-op game POPUCOM , supernatural life sim Moonlight Peaks , and intricate puzzler The House of Tesla: Definitive Edition . It's somewhat slim pickings, but at least there's some solid variety. PS Plus members can look forward to a fresh batch of games across Extra and Premium, too. Here's everything coming out this week. On this page: These 13+ PS5 and PS Plus Games Are Coming Out Next Week (16th-22nd November) 1. New PS5 Games Next Week (16th-22nd November) 2. New PS Plus Games Next Week New PS5 Games Next Week (16th-22nd November) GTA 6 finally hits PS5 on 19th November. Duck Side of the Moon (17th November - PS5): "Fly around as Doug, an overworked duck astronaut looking for a new homeworld. Crashed on a strange planet of talking rocks, maybe this twist is exactly what he needs! Whether you’re exploring or just soaking in the stars, this galaxy is here for you to enjoy at your own pace." Moonlight Peaks (17th November - PS5): "Experience life as a vampire in a magical town full of werewolves, witches, mermaids, and more! In this heart-warming, supernatural life-sim, you will raise mystical crops, learn spell-casting and potion-making, and befriend – or even romance – the locals. And at the same time, show your skeptical father that a life of compassion is possible – even for the undead." POPUCOM (17th November - PS5): "POPUCOM is a multiplayer co-op platform adventure game. As an adventurer, you are summoned to an unknown planet to embark on an exoplanet adventure with your friends. You will face various enemies and use engaging items and techniques to eliminate threats and restore the world to its former glory." Ranger's Path: National Park Simulator (17th November - PS5): "In Ranger’s Path: National Park Simulator, you take on the everyday responsibilities of a real park ranger in the stunning Faremont National Park. Restore and maintain scenic trails, assist visitors, and document wildlife in a living, breathing ecosystem." Unicorn Academy: Island of Magic (17th November - PS5): "Step into the magical world of Unicorn Academy and begin your very own adventure! Create your own first-year student at the academy and call upon the help of Unicorn Academy’s favorite characters. Groom, race and bond with your unicorn. Embark on missions to stop Ravenzella’s evil plot." Dark Rail (18th November - PS5): "Send your inquisitors out by train on deadly quests to hunt down heretics across the frontier. These expeditions cost vital supplies, can raise madness and revolt, and may leave your inquisitors wounded or broken, but they are necessary. The prisoner shipments must never stop, no matter the cost." Grand Theft Auto 6 (19th November - PS5): "Vice City, USA. Jason and Lucia have always known the deck is stacked against them. But when an easy score goes wrong, they find themselves on the darkest side of the sunniest place in America, in the middle of a criminal conspiracy stretching across the state of Leonida — forced to rely on each other more than ever if they want to make it out alive." The House of Tesla: Definitive Edition (19th November - PS5): "We invite you to step into the eerie abandoned halls of Tesla's Wardenclyffe facility and uncover the story behind one of history's greatest unfinished innovations: Nikola Tesla's ambitious vision of wireless electricity transmission. You can expect new handcrafted puzzles, hauntingly beautiful locations and challenges for your brain’s gray (or blue) matter."
